sections.title: P04.2 — independent final review
sections.text:
review: codex/gpt-6 GREEN

Fresh review session after D67; executor recorded as codex/gpt-6.1-sol. Provider/model identifiers come from session instructions and the implementation handoff; no provider-attested route receipt is claimed. One independent review, followed only by repairs of confirmed findings and affected validation. No second audit or SKM review cycle.

Reviewed candidate: `d7735d64826dd96e3cbb3b5fb9f78abbc31ad564c1250bd7c0f2ffb635913bbe`. Contracts: immutable P04.2, D07/D63/D64/D67, dev doctrine, implementation handoff. Scope: classification membership and current source seals, public-by-usage closure, finite ports/DTOs and owner adapters, latest DI extractions, transactional TaskCompletion capture, scoped Golden delta and sealed replay. Automated strict/source/layout checks cover the full declaration population; runtime semantics were traced on the affected transaction/DTO/DI paths. This is bounded P04.2 review, not proof of all possible runtime behavior.

Three confirmed findings were repaired:

- **Major — Golden serialization.** `build/p04-save-implementation.py` sorted every nested JSON object, including observable PHP constant/default array values. Golden failed on enum record ordering. Runtime collection proved all effective records semantically equal; restored only order in 45 records, retaining values and all eight authored registrar signatures. Golden now passes 4/4 without GOLDEN_UPDATE. Normalizer and assertions remain unchanged.
- **Major — stale finite surface expectation.** `packages/operations/tests/Feature/LoadContourBootTest.php` omitted `OperationPortBindings` from its exact public-api expectation. Both root and operations suites failed. Added that one actual registrar to the expected list; exact equality and negative imports/dependency checks remain intact. Root and resumed package coverage now pass.
- **Major — replay manifest path quoting.** The seal script used line-based Git output; 57 quoted non-ASCII plans paths were mistaken for absent product paths. Corrected sealing uses NUL-delimited path output and excludes actual plans paths. Candidate.patch is unchanged by this correction; final manifest has 1521 real paths and 115 mapped classes. Source equality is checked by per-path SHA-256, not counts. Corrected script retained in scripts/seal-replay.py.

No unresolved findings. Eight Laravel registrars preserve the exact binding lifetimes, implementation resolution and provider call order; their new declarations are finite Spi Call composition surfaces. ApiOptions retains the original configuration input instead of shadowing it. TaskCompletion tests prove capture before save inside the transaction, unchanged/repeated completion deduplication, disabled/missing workflow binding, and rollback of task plus receipt after a later contributor throws. JsonDocument and view/read ports close model payloads; strict scanner negatives and package graph/layout controls remain active.

Evidence: validation-final-result.json, classification-proof.json, replay-equality-final.json, golden-semantic-delta.json and validation-final/*.log. Source hashes for 1173 original classification rows and 94 new types are current; all 68 public-by-usage rows resolve. Routes/events/wire retain preimage bytes. No ceilings or negative assertions were weakened.

Validation reuse is explicit. Lint, analyse, PG/mutations and unchanged gates precede only the two Golden/test-expectation corrections; production/tool/config inputs remain unchanged. The changed test received scoped lint and repaired root/package runs. Package coverage combines the already-green six-package prefix with a serial resumed run starting at operations. Historical RED results and prior sealed replay evidence remain separate. No push/release/P04.3 work.
